column1: # The failure table of libnsl.so.1 (D-29.6, owner rulings R13 / SCOPE-REVIEW-LEGACY; spec §29.2): one row per
# export of spec/abi/versions.tsv (GLIBC_PRIVATE rows excepted, R14-12). `cargo xtask so` generates each body from its
# row (xtask/src/placeholders.rs) and crates/core/tests/s29_legacy_clauses.rs s29_2_c_0 checks every row against the
# built bodies; edit this file, never the generated C. Kinds:
#   int N      return N, errno untouched (YPERR_* for YP calls, NIS_UNAVAIL 41 for nis_error calls, FALSE for xdr_*)
#   null       return NULL with errno EOPNOTSUPP
#   result N   return a new NIS+ result object: status N, no objects, no cookie (freed by nis_freeresult)
#   free       free the pointer given (nis_freeresult: every result comes from a `result` stub)
#   text T     return the constant text T
#   textbuf T  copy T into the caller's buffer (truncated, NUL-terminated) and return it; NULL buffer or size 0: NULL
#   perror T   print `<label>: T` (or T alone without a label) and a newline to stderr
# Values from black-box probes of the reference with no NIS domain, ypbind or NIS+ cold-start file (D-29.6).
